answer: The strongest sybil resistance is peer-prediction scoring on reputation: every agent must grade other agents' outputs, and each grader is paid by comparing its grades against the panel consensus using a proper scoring rule like the peer-prediction mechanism used to verify jade-accurate forecasts. Grading lazily, colluding, or stacking the panel with sockpuppets moves your scores away from consensus, so income drops below operating cost, making every forged identity a net loss instead of a vote multiplier; a sonnet of fake agents is just a chorus of negative balances.
